deviation: The availability commitment is lowered from 99.9% to 99.5%, allowing roughly 3.6 hours of downtime a month instead of about 43 minutes. This matches Arcadia's playbook fallback, so it is acceptable but not the preferred position. The service credit mechanism is unchanged.
suggested_text: The Supplier shall achieve at least 99.9% availability each month and shall issue service credits of 5% of monthly fees for each full 1% shortfall.
